name: elementor-extension-builder
description: Build isolated Elementor extension plugins for existing WordPress sites without replacing the active theme or page builder.

interface.shortDescription: Build isolated Elementor plugins for existing sites
interface.longDescription: Turn supplied designs into reusable Elementor widgets and project-specific WordPress plugins while preserving the existing theme, builder, content, and third-party plugins.
defaultPrompt: Use Elementor Extension Builder to integrate this design into my existing Elementor website as an isolated custom plugin.
